name: Master Delver
benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks and Perception checks made to notice traps. Knowledge (dungeoneering) is always a class skill for you.
flavor: You’ve spent some time in Cassomir’s Locker and have learned a little bit to help you survive.
text:
You’ve spent some time in Cassomir’s Locker and have learned a little bit to help you survive.

**Prerequisites**: Explored part of Cassomir’s locker.

**Benefit**: You get a +2 bonus on all Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks and Perception checks made to notice traps. Knowledge (dungeoneering) is always a class skill for you.
